name: GauchoTech
description: Level up your experience with GauchoTech gaming peripherals.
story: GauchoTech, a leading Argentinian gaming hardware and software company, sees motorsport as the ultimate test of precision and performance, mirroring the demands of competitive gaming. They are eager to support rising talent and showcase their brand on a global stage. They want to align with a team that embodies innovation, passion, and dedication to excellence.
